# Sila CLI Output Golden Snapshots (`testdata/output/`)

This directory stores the deterministic golden snapshots and surface manifest
generated by the pure-Go output audit harness (`tools/outputaudit`).

> **Policy Invariant**: Python and Bash automation scripts are forbidden in this
> repository (`AGENTS.md`). `go run ./tools/outputaudit` is the only supported
> path for capturing and updating output goldens. No CI workflow files
> (`.github/workflows`) are used; verification runs locally.

## Layout

- `manifest.json` — maps every golden surface label to its command, argv, output
  mode (`human`, `json`, `json-envelope`, `toon`, `porcelain`, `help`), expected
  exit code, and relative file path under `surfaces/`.
- `surfaces/<group>/<name>.txt` (or `.json`) — UTF-8, LF-normalized,
  trailing-whitespace-trimmed golden snapshots containing normalized `stdout`,
  `stderr` (if non-empty), and exit code header.

## Running Golden Verification

```bash
cd cli
go test -race ./tools/outputaudit/...
go test -race ./cmd/sila -run TestOutputGoldenContracts
```

To inspect full untruncated sidecars and the Markdown completeness report in a
temporary directory:

```bash
cd cli
go run ./tools/outputaudit --out=/tmp/sila-output-audit
```

## Updating Goldens (Format Drift Workflow)

Normal test runs **never** auto-update golden files; any byte difference fails
`TestOutputGoldenContracts` and prints a unified line diff.

When an intentional CLI output change is made:

1. **Change**: Edit the CLI renderer or command implementation.
2. **Run harness**: Run `go test ./cmd/sila -run TestOutputGoldenContracts` to
   inspect the unified diff.
3. **Update goldens**: Regenerate the golden snapshots explicitly:
   ```bash
   go test ./cmd/sila -run TestOutputGoldenContracts -update
   # or directly:
   go run ./tools/outputaudit --golden-dir=testdata/output --update
   ```
4. **Review & commit**: Inspect `git diff testdata/output/` and commit the
   updated goldens alongside the code change.

## Normalization Rules

All captured streams are normalized longest-path-first before comparison:

| Volatile token | Replacement |
|---|---|
| Sandbox repository path | `<sandbox>/repo` |
| Sandbox `HOME` directory | `<sandbox>/home` |
| Sandbox root directory | `<sandbox>` |
| ANSI escape sequences | stripped |
| RFC3339 / ISO timestamps | `<timestamp>` |
| Execution durations (`43ms`, `1.2s`) | `<duration>` |
| Generated IDs (`fact_*`, `hoff_*`, UUIDs) | `<id>` |
| Git commit SHAs / hashes (7–40 hex) | `<sha>` |
